The value could be null if `entry.getValue()` is null, and the cast to `String` preserves null. Since `LinkedHashMap` allows null values, no `NullPointerException` is thrown.
- **IllegalArgumentException**: `LinkedHashMap` does not impose any property restrictions that would cause this exception. All string keys and values (including null) are acceptable. Hence, this exception is avoided.
